name: Abacum
description: Abacum is an AI-native FP&A platform for planning, reporting, modeling, and forecasting in one system. It offers driver-based forecasting, scenario modeling, and automated reporting, with AI-powered data cleaning and anomaly detection across 700+ integrations.
short_description: The AI-native FP&A platform you can actually run.

name: Abridge
description: Abridge is an enterprise healthcare platform that turns patient-clinician conversations into AI-generated clinical notes in real time. It supports multiple specialties and languages, integrates directly with Epic, and helps close revenue cycle gaps so notes are billable.
short_description: Real-time AI medical notes from clinical conversations

name: Activepieces
description: Open-source Zapier alternative with AI pieces and an MCP server for agent tool access.
short_description: Open-source Zapier alternative with AI pieces and an MCP server for agent tool access.
advantages: MIT-licensed core with pieces written in TypeScript that are easy to extend.
disadvantages: Far fewer integrations than Zapier or n8n.

name: Ada
description: Ada provides an agentic customer experience platform that deploys AI agents to resolve customer service interactions across channels and improve over time. The site describes omnichannel deployment across voice, messaging, and email, multilingual support with context preservation, enterprise integrations via open APIs and SDKs, performance monitoring with testing tools, and safety controls. It serves enterprise organizations across many industries.
short_description: Agentic AI customer experience platform
advantages: Mature reporting on what was resolved versus escalated.
disadvantages: Paid only, and rollout is a project rather than an afternoon.

name: AdCreative.ai
description: AdCreative.ai generates marketing assets including ads, videos, product photos, and copy, then scores them for likely performance. It can scan a website to produce instant ads, generate buyer personas, and surface competitor insights, with integrations into Google and Meta advertising.
short_description: AI ad creatives and copy built for conversion
advantages: Produces dozens of on-brand ad creatives with copy in one run, with a conversion score for each.
disadvantages: Users frequently report difficulty cancelling subscriptions and template-looking creatives.

name: Adobe Express
description: Canva-style template editor with Firefly generation, background removal and quick brand kits built in.
short_description: Canva-style template editor with Firefly generation, background removal and quick brand kits built in.
advantages: Free, high-quality background removal plus Firefly tools and Adobe Stock in a beginner-friendly editor.
disadvantages: Less mature template library and collaboration than Canva.

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe's generative image, vector and video models trained on licensed content, exposed in a web app and across Creative Cloud.
short_description: Adobe's generative image, vector and video models trained on licensed content, exposed in a web app and across Creative Cloud.
advantages: Trained on Adobe Stock and licensed data, so outputs are marketed as commercially safe with indemnification for enterprises.
disadvantages: Image quality and creativity lag Midjourney and Flux, and the generative credit system is restrictive.

name: Adobe Photoshop (Generative Fill)
description: Photoshop's Firefly-powered tools for filling, extending, removing and replacing content directly on layers.
short_description: Photoshop's Firefly-powered tools for filling, extending, removing and replacing content directly on layers.
advantages: Generative Fill and Expand work non-destructively inside a full professional editor with masks and layers.
disadvantages: Requires a Creative Cloud subscription and generative credits are limited on standard plans.

name: Adobe Podcast Enhance
description: A free web tool that removes noise and echo from voice recordings so they sound studio-recorded.
short_description: A free web tool that removes noise and echo from voice recordings so they sound studio-recorded.
advantages: Drag in a bad phone recording and it comes back sounding like a podcast mic, for free.
disadvantages: Heavy processing can add a robotic, over-smoothed quality and it only handles speech.

name: AI HomeDesign
description: AI HomeDesign prepares property listing photos using AI editing, including virtual staging, object removal, lighting and color correction, and day-to-dusk conversions. A chat-based editing mode lets users describe changes in natural language, and it supports bulk processing and imports from Zillow and Realtor.com.
short_description: AI photo editing and virtual staging for listings

name: Aider
description: Aider is an open-source, terminal-based AI pair programming tool that edits code in your local git repository and works with models such as Claude, OpenAI, and DeepSeek. It maps the codebase for context and commits changes with sensible messages.
short_description: AI pair programming in your terminal
advantages: Repo map and git-native workflow make it cheap and precise with any model, including local ones.
disadvantages: It is a chat-driven editor rather than an autonomous agent, so you steer every step.

name: AIVA
description: AI composer for instrumental, cinematic and game soundtracks with MIDI export.
short_description: AI composer for instrumental, cinematic and game soundtracks with MIDI export.
advantages: Exports MIDI stems so you can edit the composition in a DAW, which prompt-only generators cannot do.
disadvantages: No vocals and the output can sound generic without manual editing.

name: Almanack
description: Almanack helps teachers adapt, differentiate, and replan curriculum lessons - adjusting reading levels, swapping topics, and generating below-grade, above-grade, ELL, and IEP-accommodated versions. It maps curriculum to the school calendar and generates standards-aligned assessments, worksheets, and unit plans.
short_description: AI curriculum adaptation and differentiation

name: Amazon Q Developer
description: Amazon Q Developer is a generative AI assistant for software development available in IDEs, the command line, the AWS Console, and chat apps. It offers code suggestions, unit test generation, vulnerability scanning with remediation, and agentic task automation. It also provides AWS architecture guidance and can integrate private repositories for tailored recommendations.
short_description: Generative AI assistant for software development across IDEs and the CLI

name: Ambience Healthcare
description: Ambience captures and organizes clinical notes in real time during patient encounters and integrates directly into Epic. It provides coding assistance for E/M levels, ICD-10, and CPT codes, and adapts its workflows across a wide range of medical specialties.
short_description: AI platform for real-time clinical documentation and coding inside the EHR

name: Amp
description: Amp is a coding agent that runs in the terminal and can be controlled from web, mobile, or command line. It offers multiple operating modes, a Diffs feature for reviewing and staging changes, and plugin extensibility for custom workflows.
short_description: An agentic coding tool built by Sourcegraph
advantages: Threads are shareable, so a team can inspect exactly how an agent produced a change.
disadvantages: No model picker; Amp chooses the model and spends your credits accordingly.

name: Amplemarket
description: Amplemarket is an AI sales platform that combines lead generation, intent-signal detection, and multichannel engagement. Its Duo Copilot AI agent helps reps find the right leads, personalise outreach, and manage deliverability across email, social, phone, and voice.
short_description: Step into the future of sales: Human + AI

name: Anima
description: Converts Figma designs into React, Vue, or HTML code and now offers an AI design-to-app playground.
short_description: Converts Figma designs into React, Vue, or HTML code and now offers an AI design-to-app playground.
advantages: Long-standing Figma plugin that respects auto-layout and produces responsive code.
disadvantages: Generated components still need cleanup before they are production-ready.

name: Anyword
description: Anyword is an AI content platform that adds A/B-tested performance data throughout the content creation process. The site describes a performance prediction score, content intelligence analysis, a data-driven editor, brand voice management, a Chrome extension, and an API for embedding in other applications. It is aimed at marketing teams including demand generation, product, content, and SEO roles.
short_description: AI content platform with performance prediction
advantages: Predictive performance scores rank copy variants, which is more useful than another blank generator.
disadvantages: The scores are a model's guess rather than live test data, and there is no free plan beyond a trial.

name: Apollo.io
description: Apollo.io is a unified sales platform that combines a large verified contact database, multichannel outbound prospecting, inbound lead management, and deal execution. It offers data enrichment, call recording with AI summaries, and pipeline analytics in one place.
short_description: Unified sales platform with data, outreach, and deal tools
advantages: Prospecting data, email sequencing and a dialer in one tool, with a usable free tier.
disadvantages: Contact accuracy varies by segment, so emails want verifying before a send, and volume sending rests on your own warmup and sender reputation.

name: Artisan
description: Artisan offers Ava, an AI business development representative that automates outbound sales. Ava identifies and enriches leads from a verified B2B contact database, sends personalised multi-channel outreach, handles objections, and books meetings.
short_description: AI BDR for automated outbound sales

name: AskYourPDF
description: Chat with PDFs and other documents via web app, Chrome extension, ChatGPT plugin or API.
short_description: Chat with PDFs and other documents via web app, Chrome extension, ChatGPT plugin or API.
advantages: Available almost everywhere, including an API for developers who want document Q&A inside their own product.
disadvantages: Answer quality is middling on long documents and the free tier is restrictive on uploads and questions.

name: AssemblyAI
description: A speech-to-text API with diarization, sentiment, chapters and an LLM layer for summarizing transcripts.
short_description: A speech-to-text API with diarization, sentiment, chapters and an LLM layer for summarizing transcripts.
advantages: Strong accuracy plus built-in audio intelligence (speaker labels, chapters, PII redaction) and LeMUR for asking questions of a transcript.
disadvantages: No consumer app, and per-hour pricing adds up on high volumes compared with self-hosted Whisper.

name: Async
description: Formerly Podcastle: chat-based editor that cleans up audio, adds captions, dubs, and cuts long footage into short clips.
short_description: Formerly Podcastle: chat-based editor that cleans up audio, adds captions, dubs, and cuts long footage into short clips.
advantages: One chat handles cleanup, captions, dubbing and short clips.
disadvantages: Rebuilt around video in 2026, so the podcast recording studio Podcastle was known for is no longer the focus.

name: AudioCraft (MusicGen)
description: Meta's open MusicGen and AudioGen models for music and sound generation.
short_description: Meta's open MusicGen and AudioGen models for music and sound generation.
advantages: Weights and training code are public - run it locally with no quota.
disadvantages: Research code: Python and a GPU to set up, and short clips out.

name: Augment Code
description: Cosmos from Augment Code is an agentic software development platform that orchestrates AI agents through triage, authoring, review, and verification. Its context engine maps codebase structure to reduce token consumption, and it includes agents for dispatching work, authoring pull requests, and reviewing code. It integrates with Slack, GitHub, Jira, and CI systems.
short_description: Agentic platform that coordinates AI agents across the software lifecycle
advantages: Context retrieval holds up on monorepos with hundreds of thousands of files.
disadvantages: Pricing moved to credits and sits well above Copilot for individual developers.

name: Auphonic
description: Automatic audio post-production: leveling, loudness normalization, noise reduction and transcripts for podcasts.
short_description: Automatic audio post-production: leveling, loudness normalization, noise reduction and transcripts for podcasts.
advantages: Hits broadcast loudness targets and balances multiple speakers automatically, which saves manual mixing every episode.
disadvantages: The interface is dated and the per-hour credit model is awkward for occasional users.

name: AutoGen
description: Microsoft's framework for multi-agent conversations and event-driven agent applications.
short_description: Microsoft's framework for multi-agent conversations and event-driven agent applications.
advantages: AutoGen Studio offers a no-code UI for prototyping agent teams.
disadvantages: The v0.4 rewrite broke compatibility and the AG2 fork split the community.

name: AutoReel
description: AutoReel converts property photos into finished video marketing content for social media, MLS listings, and ads. Agents upload images, pick a style, and the AI assembles a video with transitions and pacing, with options for virtual staging, photo edits, voiceovers, and on-screen branding.
short_description: Turn listing photos into property marketing videos

name: Autosheet
description: Formerly GPT for Work: GPT for Sheets, Docs, Excel and Word add-ons that expose OpenAI, Anthropic and other models as spreadsheet functions and bulk tools.
short_description: Formerly GPT for Work: GPT for Sheets, Docs, Excel and Word add-ons that expose OpenAI, Anthropic and other models as spreadsheet functions and bulk tools.
advantages: Lets you choose the model per task and run bulk prompts over whole ranges with cost estimates up front.
disadvantages: Requires understanding model pricing, and large jobs can hit rate limits or time out.

name: Avoma
description: Avoma is an AI meeting assistant and revenue intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams. It records, transcribes, and summarises calls, then turns them into structured notes, coaching insights, and forecasting signals across the full meeting lifecycle.
short_description: An all-in-one AI to automate note-taking, scheduling, coaching, forecasting, and more

name: Bardeen
description: Bardeen automates workflows by combining web scraping, AI research, and contact enrichment, letting go-to-market teams describe an ideal lead so AI can prioritise prospects and remove repetitive manual steps.
short_description: Find and reach leads no one else can.

name: Base44
description: No-code AI app builder with built-in auth, database, and hosting, acquired by Wix in 2025.
short_description: No-code AI app builder with built-in auth, database, and hosting, acquired by Wix in 2025.
advantages: Backend, user management, and hosting are all included, so there is nothing to connect.
disadvantages: Limited code export and less customisation than Lovable or Bolt.

name: Basedash
description: Basedash is an AI native business intelligence platform that lets teams build dashboards, reports, and analytics by describing what they want in plain English. It connects to a wide range of databases and SaaS tools and offers an AI chat interface for asking questions about data. The platform serves product, operations, finance, and data teams.
short_description: AI business intelligence for dashboards and reports without SQL

name: Beamery
description: Beamery connects fragmented talent data and provides real-time intelligence to support hiring, skills development, and talent mobility, including an agentic AI consultant and skills intelligence, with integrations to major HRIS systems.
short_description: The AI platform for workforce transformation.

name: Beatoven.ai
description: Mood-based background music for video and podcasts, cleared for commercial use.
short_description: Mood-based background music for video and podcasts, cleared for commercial use.
advantages: Scores to a timeline and a mood instead of generating a standalone song.
disadvantages: No vocals, and the range of styles is narrow.

name: Beautiful.ai
description: Presentation software with smart templates that auto-adjust layouts as you add content, plus AI deck generation.
short_description: Presentation software with smart templates that auto-adjust layouts as you add content, plus AI deck generation.
advantages: Smart slides enforce design rules so a non-designer cannot make an ugly slide.
disadvantages: Those same constraints frustrate people who want pixel-level control, and there is no free plan.

name: Better Analyst
description: Formerly Formula Bot: describe a calculation and get the Excel or Sheets formula, now alongside connected data sources and dashboards.
short_description: Formerly Formula Bot: describe a calculation and get the Excel or Sheets formula, now alongside connected data sources and dashboards.
advantages: Explains the formula it writes, which is how you learn the function.
disadvantages: Multi-sheet logic still needs checking by hand.

name: BILL
description: BILL is a financial operations platform handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, spend and expense, and cash flow forecasting. AI works behind the scenes to automate bill and invoice processing, categorise expenses, and route approvals, with integrations to QuickBooks and Sage Intacct.
short_description: AI-powered AP, AR, and spend automation for SMBs

name: Bland AI
description: Phone-call agents at volume, on infrastructure the company runs end to end.
short_description: Phone-call agents at volume, on infrastructure the company runs end to end.
advantages: Owning the whole pipeline keeps latency down and the per-minute price predictable at scale.
disadvantages: A closed stack: the voices and models on offer are theirs, not yours.

name: Bolt.new
description: Bolt is an AI platform for creating websites, apps, and prototypes through conversation, with automated testing and code refinement. It includes backend infrastructure such as databases, hosting, and authentication, plus design system integrations. The tool serves product managers, entrepreneurs, marketers, agencies, and students.
short_description: AI agent for building apps and websites by chatting
advantages:
Supports multiple frameworks and lets you edit the code directly in the browser IDE.
Runs npm, dev servers, and builds entirely in the browser so nothing is installed.
disadvantages:
Token usage is hard to predict and large projects become slow and error-prone.
Token-metered pricing burns through the monthly allowance on larger projects.

name: Booke AI
description: Booke AI is an AI bookkeeper that integrates with QuickBooks Online and Xero to process bank feeds, categorize transactions, match them to invoices and bills, and reconcile each morning. It supports custom threshold rules, audit trails with document trails, and inconsistency detection. It also includes a client query tool and a Chrome extension for bulk reconciliation.
short_description: AI bookkeeper that automates daily tasks in QuickBooks Online and Xero

name: Botpress
description: Visual builder for LLM chat agents with tools, knowledge bases and channels.
short_description: Visual builder for LLM chat agents with tools, knowledge bases and channels.
advantages: Flow editor with real code escape hatches, and it deploys to WhatsApp and Slack.
disadvantages: Free credits run out quickly once a bot gets traffic.

name: Brainly
description: Homework question-and-answer community with an AI tutor that explains the answer.
short_description: Homework question-and-answer community with an AI tutor that explains the answer.
advantages: Huge back catalogue of school questions that are already answered.
disadvantages: Community answers vary in quality and the site pushes subscriptions hard.

name: Brandmark
description: AI logo generator that combines curated icons, fonts and color palettes into brand identities.
short_description: AI logo generator that combines curated icons, fonts and color palettes into brand identities.
advantages: Typography and color pairings look more considered than most logo makers.
disadvantages: Icon-plus-wordmark layouts feel samey and editing after purchase is limited.

name: Brex
description: Brex is an AI-powered finance platform that automates expense management, spending controls, payments, and accounting processes. It offers corporate cards, in-app travel booking, AI-powered bill pay, and banking and treasury with cash management. It provides AI-generated accounting suggestions and ERP integrations.
short_description: AI-powered finance platform for business spending and operations

name: Brisk Teaching
description: Brisk Teaching is an AI assistant that runs inside the Google and Microsoft tools teachers already use. It generates lesson plans, quizzes, and presentations, provides student feedback, adjusts reading levels, and inspects student writing - without requiring new software.
short_description: AI that works where educators work.

name: Browser Use
description: Open-source Python library that lets LLM agents control a real browser via Playwright.
short_description: Open-source Python library that lets LLM agents control a real browser via Playwright.
advantages: Extracts interactive elements into a compact DOM representation so agents click reliably with cheap models.
disadvantages: Flaky on sites with heavy anti-bot protection and sensitive to model choice.

name: Browserbase
description: Hosted headless browser infrastructure for AI agents with stealth, proxies, and session replay.
short_description: Hosted headless browser infrastructure for AI agents with stealth, proxies, and session replay.
advantages: Scales browser sessions without managing Chrome, with recordings for debugging.
disadvantages: Costs climb quickly with concurrent sessions and proxy usage.

name: Buffer
description: Schedules posts across every network and drafts them from a note with an AI assistant.
short_description: Schedules posts across every network and drafts them from a note with an AI assistant.
advantages: The free plan is genuinely usable, and the AI drafts read like the account's own voice once fed a few posts.
disadvantages: Analytics and engagement sit behind the paid tiers.

name: Builder.io
description: Builder.io combines a visual editor wired to production components with AI assistance and an agentic CMS, so teams ship code without handoffs. It also converts Figma designs directly into production-ready components.
short_description: Build software with your team and agents
advantages: Mitosis-based output targets React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and more from one design.
disadvantages: Best results require Builder's design-system mapping setup first.

name: Campfire
description: Campfire is an AI-native ERP and accounting platform that unifies general ledger, revenue, reporting, and close management. Its Ember AI handles transaction categorisation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation, with multi-entity consolidation and real-time reporting for high-growth finance teams.
short_description: AI-native ERP that multiplies what your team can do.

name: Canva Magic Studio
description: Canva's AI suite (Magic Design, Magic Write, Magic Media) for generating presentations, social posts and copy inside its design editor.
short_description: Canva's AI suite (Magic Design, Magic Write, Magic Media) for generating presentations, social posts and copy inside its design editor.
advantages: Generates a full deck or social campaign and then lets you edit every element in the familiar Canva editor.
disadvantages: AI output leans on Canva's template look, and the most useful Magic features need a Pro subscription.

name: CapCut
description: Free cross-platform video editor with auto captions, background removal, AI dubbing, templates and a long-video-to-shorts tool.
short_description: Free cross-platform video editor with auto captions, background removal, AI dubbing, templates and a long-video-to-shorts tool.
advantages: The most capable free editor for short-form, with TikTok-native templates and captions.
disadvantages: Features keep migrating behind Pro, and its ByteDance ownership raises data and availability concerns in some regions.

name: Captions
description: Creator video app with AI captions, eye-contact correction, dubbing with lip sync and AI avatars (Mirage).
short_description: Creator video app with AI captions, eye-contact correction, dubbing with lip sync and AI avatars (Mirage).
advantages: Eye-contact correction and lip-synced dubbing work well on phone-shot talking-head video.
disadvantages: The subscription is expensive relative to CapCut and many effects feel gimmicky.

name: Cartesia
description: Sonic: very low-latency voice generation built for live conversation.
short_description: Sonic: very low-latency voice generation built for live conversation.
advantages: Latency low enough for a voice agent that can be interrupted.
disadvantages: Fewer polished preset voices than ElevenLabs, and it is API-first.

name: Chatbase
description: Build a custom support chatbot trained on your website, docs and files and embed it with a snippet.
short_description: Build a custom support chatbot trained on your website, docs and files and embed it with a snippet.
advantages: Paste a URL and have a working embedded bot in minutes, with actions for lookups and lead capture.
disadvantages: Message credits are tight on lower tiers, and answers drift when the source content is thin.

name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's general-purpose chat assistant with web browsing, file analysis, image generation and voice.
short_description: OpenAI's general-purpose chat assistant with web browsing, file analysis, image generation and voice.
advantages: The broadest feature set in one place: Deep Research, code-executing data analysis on uploaded spreadsheets, voice mode and a huge library of custom GPTs.
disadvantages: Free and Plus tiers hit message caps on the best models at busy times, and answers can be confidently wrong without citations unless you ask it to search.

name: ChatGPT Agent (Operator)
description: OpenAI's hosted agent, formerly Operator, that browses websites and completes tasks in a virtual computer.
short_description: OpenAI's hosted agent, formerly Operator, that browses websites and completes tasks in a virtual computer.
advantages: No setup: it runs in OpenAI's own browser and pauses for you to log in or confirm purchases.
disadvantages: Slow, limited monthly task quota, and blocked by many sites' bot defences.

name: ChatGPT Images (GPT Image / DALL-E)
description: Image generation and editing built into ChatGPT, driven by conversational prompts and reference uploads.
short_description: Image generation and editing built into ChatGPT, driven by conversational prompts and reference uploads.
advantages: Follows complex, multi-step instructions and renders legible text and diagrams better than most rivals.
disadvantages: Generation is slow and rate-limited, and outputs often carry a recognizable yellowish tint.

name: ChatPDF
description: Upload a PDF and ask questions about it in chat, with answers linked to page references.
short_description: Upload a PDF and ask questions about it in chat, with answers linked to page references.
advantages: Zero setup: drop a PDF and start asking, with page citations for every answer.
disadvantages: Free plan caps file size and page count, and long or scanned PDFs often produce vague answers.

name: Chatwoot
description: Open-source customer engagement suite with an AI agent for replies and summaries.
short_description: Open-source customer engagement suite with an AI agent for replies and summaries.
advantages: Self-host the whole helpdesk - the AI is an add-on, not the lock-in.
disadvantages: You run the infrastructure, and the AI features need your own model key.

name: CINC
description: CINC is a real estate CRM and lead generation platform that helps agents and teams generate, manage, and convert buyer and seller leads. It combines managed Google and Facebook ad campaigns, an IDX consumer search site, and automation, with CINC AI providing text-based conversation intelligence to surface leads ready to talk.
short_description: All-in-one real estate lead generation and CRM

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's chat assistant known for careful long-form writing, large context windows and Projects for working over document sets.
short_description: Anthropic's chat assistant known for careful long-form writing, large context windows and Projects for working over document sets.
advantages: Produces natural, editable prose and follows nuanced instructions over very long documents better than most rivals.
disadvantages: Pro usage limits can run out mid-session on long conversations, and it has no built-in image generation.

name: Claude Agent SDK
description: SDK exposing the Claude Code agent loop, tools, and MCP support for building custom agents in Python or TypeScript.
short_description: SDK exposing the Claude Code agent loop, tools, and MCP support for building custom agents in Python or TypeScript.
advantages: Inherits Claude Code's file, shell, and subagent tooling, so agents are production-grade on day one.
disadvantages: Tied to Claude models and the Claude Code runtime rather than a provider-agnostic design.

name: Claude API
description: Anthropic's Messages API and SDKs for Claude models, with tool use, prompt caching, and batch processing.
short_description: Anthropic's Messages API and SDKs for Claude models, with tool use, prompt caching, and batch processing.
advantages: Claude models lead on agentic coding and long-context tasks.
disadvantages: Tighter rate limits on new accounts and no free tier beyond trial credits.

name: Claude Code
description: Terminal-based agentic coding tool that reads, edits, tests, and commits in your repo.
short_description: Terminal-based agentic coding tool that reads, edits, tests, and commits in your repo.
advantages: Handles long multi-step tasks across a whole repo with strong tool use and MCP support.
disadvantages: Token spend on the API plan can be high and Pro-plan rate limits reset only every five hours.

name: Claude for Chrome
description: Chrome extension that lets Claude browse, click, and fill forms inside your own logged-in browser.
short_description: Chrome extension that lets Claude browse, click, and fill forms inside your own logged-in browser.
advantages: Uses your existing sessions and cookies, so no separate logins in a remote browser.
disadvantages: Limited rollout and deliberately conservative about actions on sensitive sites.

name: Clay
description: Clay is a go-to-market platform combining data enrichment, AI agents, and workflow automation to help teams find prospects and run targeted campaigns. The site describes access to 150+ data sources, waterfall enrichment, Claygents research agents, intent and job-change signals, a natural language workflow builder, and CRM enrichment. It serves sales, marketing, and revenue operations teams.
short_description: Go-to-market data enrichment and AI research agents
advantages: Claygent researches each lead on the web and writes a personalized first line at scale.
disadvantages: Credit consumption is hard to predict and the learning curve is steep.

name: Cleanup.pictures
description: Browser tool that removes objects, people, text or defects from a photo by painting over them.
short_description: Browser tool that removes objects, people, text or defects from a photo by painting over them.
advantages: Removes unwanted objects in seconds with no account or software install.
disadvantages: Free use is capped at 720px output and large removals leave smeary fills.

name: CleanVoice
description: Strips filler words, stutters and mouth sounds from podcast recordings.
short_description: Strips filler words, stutters and mouth sounds from podcast recordings.
advantages: Catches ums, repeated takes and dead air without editing by hand.
disadvantages: Does nothing for levels or room tone - it is an editor, not a mastering pass.

name: Clearbrief
description: Clearbrief is an AI legal writing tool built into Microsoft Word that helps attorneys draft briefs and motions while verifying that citations point to real, supporting evidence. It emphasises fact-checking to guard against fabricated case citations.
short_description: Cite facts, not fake cases

name: Clearscope
description: Term coverage reports trusted by in-house content teams, inside Docs and WordPress.
short_description: Term coverage reports trusted by in-house content teams, inside Docs and WordPress.
advantages: The reports are conservative and clean, which is why editors trust them.
disadvantages: Priced out of reach for anyone publishing a few posts a month.

name: Cline
description: Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code with plan/act modes and MCP support.
short_description: Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code with plan/act modes and MCP support.
advantages: Plan mode lets you approve an approach before the agent touches files or runs commands.
disadvantages: Reading whole files into context burns API tokens fast on big projects.

name: Clipdrop
description: Clipdrop is an AI image editing platform offering background removal, object cleanup, upscaling, and text-to-image generation. It serves both end users and developers through web apps and an API.
short_description: Create and edit visuals in seconds with AI
advantages: Many useful single-purpose tools (relight, uncrop, reimagine) under one roof with an API.
disadvantages: Since the move from Stability AI to Jasper, several tools have been pared back and the model updates have slowed.

name: Cloze
description: Cloze is an AI CRM that automatically syncs calls, texts, and emails and surfaces re-engagement and cross-sell opportunities. It includes marketing automation for campaigns and newsletters, lead routing with attribution tracking, and a mobile-first design. It integrates with Gmail, Microsoft 365, Slack, Docusign, and other platforms.
short_description: AI-powered CRM for real estate brokerages and agents

name: CoCounsel Legal
description: CoCounsel Legal combines legal research, document analysis, and drafting in one workflow using generative and agentic AI alongside authoritative legal content. It can generate jurisdiction-aware drafts and review large document sets, and integrates with Westlaw, Practical Law, and Microsoft 365.
short_description: AI legal assistant for research, document analysis, and drafting

name: Codeium
description: AI coding suggestions
short_description: AI coding suggestions

name: CodeRabbit
description: CodeRabbit automates pull request review across GitHub, GitLab, Azure, and Bitbucket, flagging bugs, security issues, and standards violations with context. It offers AI-assisted fixes and learns team preferences over time.
short_description: AI code review across your pull requests and IDE
advantages: Reviews are context-aware across the repo and learn from your replies to comments.
disadvantages: Can be noisy, posting many nitpicks per PR until you tune the config.

name: Cody
description: Cody is an AI coding assistant from Sourcegraph that uses current models together with codebase context to help developers understand, write, and fix code. It pulls context through Sourcegraph's search to surface APIs, symbols, and usage patterns across a codebase. It works in VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, and a web app.
short_description: AI coding assistant that uses development context to write and fix code

name: Cognigy
description: Cognigy (NiCE Cognigy) is an enterprise AI customer service platform that powers generative AI agents for voice, chat, and messaging. It includes an agent copilot for real-time assistance to human agents and orchestration across contact-center channels.
short_description: AI-first CX, made real

name: Cognism
description: Cognism is a B2B sales-intelligence platform that provides phone-verified contact data, intent and hiring signals, and CRM enrichment. It helps sales teams identify decision-makers and build prospecting lists with a compliance-first focus on European markets.
short_description: Europe's most trusted B2B data for growing pipeline

name: Collov AI
description: Collov AI transforms property photos with AI-powered virtual staging and editing. Users can add or remove furniture, restyle interiors, enhance lighting and color, and adjust exteriors with effects like twilight and lawn replacement, helping listings present more clearly online.
short_description: AI virtual staging and interior design for listings

name: Colossyan
description: Avatar video generator aimed at workplace learning, with document-to-video, quizzes and branching scenarios.
short_description: Avatar video generator aimed at workplace learning, with document-to-video, quizzes and branching scenarios.
advantages: Interactive learning features like in-video quizzes and branching that Synthesia lacks.
disadvantages: Smaller avatar and voice library and fewer integrations than HeyGen or Synthesia.

name: ComfyUI
description: Node-based open-source interface for building image, video and audio generation pipelines locally.
short_description: Node-based open-source interface for building image, video and audio generation pipelines locally.
advantages: Gets day-one support for new open models (Flux, Wan, Hunyuan) and lets you wire up any pipeline you can imagine.
disadvantages: The node graph has a steep learning curve and shared workflows frequently break on missing custom nodes.

name: Conker
description: Conker is an AI-powered quiz and formative assessment tool for K-12 teachers. It generates standards-aligned quizzes with varied question types in a few clicks, includes read-aloud accessibility, and exports to Google Forms and Canvas.
short_description: Fast and easy tools for creating quizzes and formative assessments.

name: Consensus
description: A search engine over peer-reviewed papers that summarizes what the research says and shows a yes/no/possibly meter.
short_description: A search engine over peer-reviewed papers that summarizes what the research says and shows a yes/no/possibly meter.
advantages: The Consensus Meter gives an at-a-glance split of studies supporting or opposing a claim, with each paper linked.
disadvantages: Only indexes academic literature, so it is useless for questions the scientific record does not cover, and paper summaries can oversimplify findings.

name: Continue
description: Open-source AI code assistant extension that lets you wire any model into VS Code or JetBrains.
short_description: Open-source AI code assistant extension that lets you wire any model into VS Code or JetBrains.
advantages: Works with local Ollama models or any API, with fully customisable config.
disadvantages: Setup is more fiddly than Copilot and autocomplete quality depends entirely on the model you choose.

name: Convai
description: Platform for embodied conversational characters with speech, actions and scene awareness for games and simulations.
short_description: Platform for embodied conversational characters with speech, actions and scene awareness for games and simulations.
advantages: Characters can perceive and act in the 3D scene, not just talk.
disadvantages: Free tier is small and integrating actions takes real engineering work.

name: Copy.ai
description: Copy.ai is a go-to-market AI platform that unifies data and automates workflows across marketing, sales, and operations. It offers workflows, actions, and agents as building blocks, a Tables data foundation, and Brand Voice for consistent output, with thousands of integrations including Salesforce and HubSpot.
short_description: Go-to-market AI platform for marketing and sales workflows
advantages: Workflows can enrich a lead list and generate personalized outreach copy end to end without code.
disadvantages: The pivot to workflows made the product more complex and pricey for someone who just wants a quick ad headline.

name: Copyleaks
description: Plagiarism and AI-content detection with LMS integrations and an API, used by schools and enterprises.
short_description: Plagiarism and AI-content detection with LMS integrations and an API, used by schools and enterprises.
advantages: Supports 30+ languages and integrates with Canvas, Moodle and Blackboard.
disadvantages: Credit-based pricing is confusing, and false positives on edited human text are common.

name: CoSupport AI
description: CoSupport AI automates customer support interactions across chat, email, social media, and helpdesk systems. It offers an AI agent for repetitive requests and an AI assistant for support teams, with no-code setup and integrations into helpdesk platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, and Intercom.
short_description: AI platform that automates customer support across channels

name: Coursebox AI
description: Coursebox is an AI powered platform that automates online course creation from prompts, documents, and images. It can generate assessments, convert files to eLearning, and includes an AI tutor for learners along with white label and LMS integration options. The platform serves L&D teams, trainers, instructional designers, and course creators.
short_description: AI course creation platform that builds courses from content

name: Create
description: Text-to-app builder that generates sites, apps, and tools with integrated AI and payments.
short_description: Text-to-app builder that generates sites, apps, and tools with integrated AI and payments.
advantages: Built-in integrations for AI models, Stripe, and databases without API wiring.
disadvantages: Smaller community and fewer templates than Lovable or v0.

name: CrewAI
description: Python framework for orchestrating role-based multi-agent crews and flows.
short_description: Python framework for orchestrating role-based multi-agent crews and flows.
advantages: Role, goal, and task abstractions make multi-agent setups readable in a few lines.
disadvantages: Agents can loop or burn tokens unpredictably with little low-level control.

name: Crowdin
description: Translation management with a multi-step AI Pipeline, in-context editing and an AI assistant inside your projects.
short_description: Translation management with a multi-step AI Pipeline, in-context editing and an AI assistant inside your projects.
advantages: Free for open source and wires into GitHub pull requests.
disadvantages: The AI is a first pass; shipping text still wants a human reviewer.

name: Cube
description: Cube is an FP&A platform that provides a unified data layer syncing financial information across spreadsheets, presentations, chat, and AI assistants. It adds governance and bi-directional sync on top of existing tools, with AI agents for data integrity, analysis, planning, and reporting.
short_description: Clean, decision-ready data everywhere FP&A happens.

name: Curipod
description: Curipod is a classroom platform that combines teacher-led lessons with AI-powered writing feedback and student engagement. Students get real-time feedback on writing during class, while teachers receive analytics on responses, misconceptions, and learning gaps.
short_description: Writing practice students love.

name: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-powered code editor and agent that can build, test, and demo features end to end. It offers accurate tab autocomplete, full codebase understanding through semantic search and indexing, and integrations with the terminal, Slack, and GitHub pull requests, with a choice of leading models.
short_description: AI code editor with agentic development and codebase context
advantages: Tab autocomplete predicts multi-line edits across files better than any competitor.
disadvantages: Usage-based pricing changes and request limits on Pro have repeatedly frustrated heavy users.

name: D-ID
description: Animates a single photo into a talking avatar and offers real-time conversational agents and video translation.
short_description: Animates a single photo into a talking avatar and offers real-time conversational agents and video translation.
advantages: Cheapest way to animate any still portrait into speech, with a well-documented API.
disadvantages: Photo-based avatars have limited head and body movement and can look uncanny.

name: DALL-E
description: AI image generation from text
short_description: AI image generation from text

name: DataRails
description: DataRails provides AI for finance and FP&A teams built on a governed semantic data layer that locks in a company's definitions of revenue, margin, and variance. It supports automated variance analysis with generated narratives, scenario modelling, close process automation, multi-entity consolidation, and live P&L with drill-down.
short_description: AI for FP&A on top of a governed financial data layer

name: Decagon
description: Decagon builds omnichannel AI agents for customer service across voice, chat, and email. It uses Agent Operating Procedures to define workflows in natural language, with cross-channel conversation memory plus testing, optimisation, and analytics tools.
short_description: The AI concierge for every customer
advantages: Built to close tickets, with QA and reporting on what it actually answered.
disadvantages: Enterprise sales cycle and no self-serve tier.

name: Decktopus
description: AI deck builder that writes the content and keeps the design on rails.
short_description: AI deck builder that writes the content and keeps the design on rails.
advantages: Picks layout, copy and images together, so the first draft already looks finished.
disadvantages: Paid only, and you work in its editor rather than PowerPoint.

name: Deepgram
description: A speech-to-text and text-to-speech API built for low-latency streaming at scale.
short_description: A speech-to-text and text-to-speech API built for low-latency streaming at scale.
advantages: Among the fastest real-time transcription APIs available, with diarization and keyword boosting built in.
disadvantages: Developer-only; there is no end-user app, and accuracy on heavily accented speech trails Whisper-class models.

name: DeepL
description: Neural machine translation praised for natural output in European languages, plus DeepL Write for editing.
short_description: Neural machine translation praised for natural output in European languages, plus DeepL Write for editing.
advantages: Translations read more naturally than Google Translate for German, French, Spanish and other European languages, and it translates whole documents with formatting intact.
disadvantages: Covers far fewer languages than Google Translate and the free tier caps document size.

name: DeepScribe
description: DeepScribe is an ambient AI platform that captures clinical conversations and generates documentation, with added coding and pre-visit preparation. It is oriented toward specialty care and value-based care organisations.
short_description: Ambient AI documentation that simplifies care

name: Definely
description: Definely is AI-powered software that helps lawyers read and review intricate contracts inside Microsoft Word without losing their place. It surfaces related definitions, provisions and cross-references, and flags the cascading effects of edits across clauses and schedules.
short_description: Structured review tools for lawyers working on complex contracts

name: Descript
description: Descript is an AI video and podcast editing platform where editing video works by editing text. The site describes automatic transcription, screen recording, live recording rooms, and AI features including captions, avatars, voice cloning, background removal, and filler word removal. It serves marketing teams, sales enablement, learning and development, and content creators.
short_description: AI video and podcast editing by editing the transcript
advantages: Deleting a word from the transcript deletes it from the audio, and Studio Sound removes room echo and noise in one click.
disadvantages: Studio Sound can make voices sound processed, and the desktop app is heavy on large projects.

name: Designs.ai
description: Designs.ai is an AI design platform that lets users create images, videos, copy, designs, audio, and slides from a single interface. It includes branding tools for logos, color systems, and typography, and offers brand consistency features across outputs. The platform is aimed at marketing teams and enterprises.
short_description: AI design suite for images, videos, copy, slides, and audio
advantages: One subscription covers logo, video and voice instead of three tools.
disadvantages: Each module is weaker than the specialist it competes with.

name: Devin
description: Devin, by Cognition, is an autonomous AI software engineer available via cloud, desktop, and CLI. It handles tasks such as code migrations, refactors, pull request review, bug fixing, and documentation, and integrates with tools like GitHub, Linear, and Slack.
short_description: An autonomous AI software engineer
advantages: Runs fully unattended in its own VM with browser, shell, and editor, and reports back on Slack.
disadvantages: Struggles with ambiguous tasks and the price per compute unit adds up on long sessions.

name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
description: Cognition's agent command centre, built on the Windsurf editor, for driving local and cloud Devin agents.
short_description: Cognition's agent command centre, built on the Windsurf editor, for driving local and cloud Devin agents.
advantages: Runs local and cloud agents from one window, with the editor's own view of what you just changed.
disadvantages: Renamed from Windsurf in June 2026 and the Cascade agent was retired, so older guides and tutorials no longer match the app.

name: Diffit
description: Diffit is an AI tool for teachers that creates and adapts instructional materials for diverse classrooms. From a topic, PDF, link, or video it generates leveled texts, summaries, vocabulary lists, and comprehension questions differentiated by grade and reading level.
short_description: Make learning accessible to all.

name: Dify
description: Open-source LLMOps platform with a visual builder for agents, RAG pipelines, and workflows.
short_description: Open-source LLMOps platform with a visual builder for agents, RAG pipelines, and workflows.
advantages: Covers prompt management, knowledge bases, and deployable APIs in one self-hostable app.
disadvantages: Complex workflows get unwieldy in the visual canvas and version control is weak.

name: Digits
description: Digits is an AI-native general ledger that provides automated books, month-end close, bill pay, invoicing, and real-time financials in one system. It offers an AI financial assistant called Ask Digits and automated accrual schedules, with around-the-clock transaction categorization. It includes interactive reporting, mobile apps, and a developer API with MCP support.
short_description: AI-native general ledger for business owners and accountants

name: Docling
description: Turns PDFs, Office files and scans into structured markdown or JSON, layout and tables intact.
short_description: Turns PDFs, Office files and scans into structured markdown or JSON, layout and tables intact.
advantages: Reads a table as a table, and does it on your own machine with nothing sent anywhere.
disadvantages: Heavy scanned documents want a GPU; CPU-only runs are slow on long PDFs.

name: Docyt
description: Docyt is an AI powered bookkeeping and accounting platform that automates expense management, bank and revenue reconciliation, transaction categorization, and financial reporting. It supports month end close automation and multi entity consolidation, and integrates with banks, POS systems, and payroll platforms. The platform serves accounting firms, finance teams, and businesses in sectors such as hospitality.
short_description: AI accounting and bookkeeping automation platform

name: Drivetrain
description: Drivetrain is an AI-native business planning platform that automates budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and consolidation. It centralises real-time data from multiple systems and supports scenario modeling and collaborative planning across finance and cross-functional teams.
short_description: The AI-native business planning platform.

name: Duolingo Max
description: Duolingo Max is Duolingo's AI-powered tier that adds conversational practice to language learning. Video Call lets learners hold real-time conversations with the character Lily, Roleplay offers real-world conversation challenges with in-app characters, and Explain My Answer gives personalised grammar explanations of mistakes.
short_description: AI language practice with conversation and grammar help
advantages: Video Call puts you in an unscripted spoken conversation that adapts to your level inside the app you already use.
disadvantages: Pricey relative to Super Duolingo, and the AI features are only available for a subset of courses.

name: Edcafe AI
description: Edcafe AI is an AI toolkit that helps teachers create and organize instructional content including slides, quizzes, flashcards, and lesson plans. Educators can build a custom AI chatbot from their own materials and use an assignment grader and reading activity generator. The platform states it is SOC 2, GDPR, FERPA, and COPPA compliant.
short_description: AI toolkit for educators to create teaching materials

name: Education Copilot
description: Education Copilot generates standards-aligned classroom resources from a grade level and subject, including lesson plans with objectives and assessments, worksheets, presentations, rubrics, quizzes, and unit syllabi. It supports differentiation by reading level and exports to PDF, Google Docs, Word, and slides.
short_description: AI lesson planning and classroom resources

name: Eightfold AI
description: Eightfold AI is an agentic talent intelligence platform that helps HR leaders, recruiters, and people managers hire, develop, and deploy talent. It includes an AI interviewer that evaluates candidates at scale, talent acquisition and management tools, and skills intelligence drawing on a large skills dataset. TalentForge lets organizations build tailored talent software on the platform.
short_description: AI talent intelligence platform for hiring and workforce management

name: Eightify
description: A browser extension that summarizes YouTube videos into key ideas with timestamps.
short_description: A browser extension that summarizes YouTube videos into key ideas with timestamps.
advantages: Summaries appear next to the video with timestamped sections, so you can jump straight to the part you care about.
disadvantages: Free summaries are capped per week and the extension is YouTube-only.

name: Elai.io
description: Text-to-video avatar platform with presentation and article-to-video conversion and multilingual dubbing.
short_description: Text-to-video avatar platform with presentation and article-to-video conversion and multilingual dubbing.
advantages: Converts PowerPoint and blog posts into avatar videos with little setup.
disadvantages: Avatar realism and lip sync are a notch below HeyGen.

name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs is an AI audio platform offering ultra-realistic text-to-speech, music and sound-effect generation, voice cloning, dubbing, and speech-to-text across 70+ languages. It also provides conversational AI agents and developer APIs.
short_description: AI voice, audio, and creative generation
advantages: Voices carry emotion and pacing that still beat most competitors, and AI dubbing translates a video while keeping the speaker's voice.
disadvantages: Character-based credits run out fast on long scripts, and voice cloning raises consent and misuse concerns.

name: ElevenLabs Agents
description: Conversational agents on the voices ElevenLabs is known for, with telephony attached.
short_description: Conversational agents on the voices ElevenLabs is known for, with telephony attached.
advantages: The voice is the best part of the stack and it is included rather than bolted on.
disadvantages: Minutes are priced as voice, not as orchestration - heavy call volume gets expensive.

name: ElevenLabs Dubbing
description: Dubbing studio that translates video or audio while preserving each speaker's cloned voice, emotion and timing.
short_description: Dubbing studio that translates video or audio while preserving each speaker's cloned voice, emotion and timing.
advantages: The most natural dubbed voices available, retaining the original speaker's tone across 29+ languages.
disadvantages: No lip sync, and dubbing credits are consumed quickly on the cheaper plans.

name: Elicit
description: A research assistant that finds papers and extracts their methods, sample sizes and findings into a comparison table.
short_description: A research assistant that finds papers and extracts their methods, sample sizes and findings into a comparison table.
advantages: Turns dozens of papers into a structured table of extracted data columns, which is exactly what a literature review needs.
disadvantages: Free credits run out quickly, and extracted fields need spot-checking against the source PDF.

name: ELSA Speak
description: An English pronunciation coach that scores each sound you say and runs AI conversation practice.
short_description: An English pronunciation coach that scores each sound you say and runs AI conversation practice.
advantages: Phoneme-level feedback shows exactly which sounds in a word you are mispronouncing.
disadvantages: English-only, and the scoring can be strict on perfectly intelligible accents.

name: Enhancv
description: Resume builder with AI content checks and templates that still parse.
short_description: Resume builder with AI content checks and templates that still parse.
advantages: Flags weak bullets and missing numbers against the job you paste in.
disadvantages: The good templates and unlimited downloads are paid.

name: Eve
description: Eve provides AI tools for plaintiff firms across the case lifecycle, from intake and evaluation through pre-litigation and resolution. It automates drafting, medical chronology building and caseload review so firms can handle more cases.
short_description: An AI operating system for plaintiff law firms

name: Fathom
description: Fathom records, transcribes, and summarises meetings with or without a bot in the call, generating action items and a searchable record, and lets users query past conversations with an Ask Fathom feature.
short_description: AI notetaking so you can focus on the conversation.
advantages: The free plan has no recording limit, and summaries are ready seconds after the call ends.
disadvantages: Requires a desktop app and a visible bot in the meeting; advanced summary templates and CRM sync are paid.

name: Figma AI (Figma Make)
description: Figma AI brings AI features into Figma's design platform, including Figma Make for generating functional prototypes from prompts, image and content editing, automatic layer renaming, background removal, and copy rewriting. It also speeds up repetitive tasks and connects design context to coding tools via the Figma MCP server.
short_description: AI features for design generation, editing, and workflow
advantages: Works inside the tool design teams already use and can start from your existing designs.
disadvantages: Make output ignores design systems unless carefully steered and AI credits are metered.

name: Figma Make
description: Figma's prompt-to-app tool that turns designs or descriptions into working prototypes and code.
short_description: Figma's prompt-to-app tool that turns designs or descriptions into working prototypes and code.
advantages: Starts from your existing Figma frames and design system, not a blank prompt.
disadvantages: Output is prototype-grade and harder to hand off to a real codebase than v0.

name: Fin by Intercom
description: Fin is an AI customer service agent that resolves complex customer inquiries across voice, email, chat, and social channels. It trains on a company's knowledge base and policies, offers a testing environment to simulate conversations, and integrates with helpdesks like Zendesk, Salesforce, and HubSpot.
short_description: AI customer service agent across voice, email, and chat
advantages: Pay-per-resolution pricing and consistently high measured resolution rates on real support queues.
disadvantages: Per-resolution fees scale unpredictably, and it is most compelling if you already use Intercom.

name: Final Round AI
description: An interview copilot that listens to live interviews and suggests answers in real time, plus mock interviews and resume tools.
short_description: An interview copilot that listens to live interviews and suggests answers in real time, plus mock interviews and resume tools.
advantages: Real-time answer prompts during a video interview, which nothing else in this category offers as openly.
disadvantages: Live-interview use may breach employer or platform policy, and refunds run on a 3-day window with minimal-use conditions.

name: Findem
description: Findem is an AI talent intelligence platform for hiring and workforce planning that analyses career history contextually and maps professional relationships rather than matching on resume keywords alone.
short_description: Built to find what builds people.

name: Firebase Studio
description: Browser-based agentic development environment that prototypes full-stack apps and deploys them to Firebase.
short_description: Browser-based agentic development environment that prototypes full-stack apps and deploys them to Firebase.
advantages: Goes from prompt to a deployed Firebase-backed app without leaving the browser.
disadvantages: The App Prototyping agent is Next.js-centric and the cloud IDE can feel sluggish.

name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that transcribes, records, summarizes, and analyzes conversations across meetings, calls, and chat platforms. It supports 100+ languages with speaker recognition, generates action items and custom notes, and offers an AI question-answering feature called AskFred. It integrates with over 200 apps including Salesforce, HubSpot, and Slack, and states SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance.
short_description: AI meeting assistant for transcription, summaries, and analysis
advantages: Deep integration list (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Notion) and searchable transcripts across every past meeting.
disadvantages: Speaker labeling and accuracy drop on noisy or accented audio, and the bot joining every calendar event by default surprises people.

name: Fireworks AI
description: Fast inference platform for open models with fine-tuning, function calling, and compound AI features.
short_description: Fast inference platform for open models with fine-tuning, function calling, and compound AI features.
advantages: Strong throughput on DeepSeek and Llama with serverless and on-demand GPU options.
disadvantages: Smaller community and documentation than Together or Hugging Face.

name: Fish Speech
description: Open multilingual text-to-speech with few-shot voice cloning.
short_description: Open multilingual text-to-speech with few-shot voice cloning.
advantages: Clones a voice from seconds of audio and runs on your own GPU.
disadvantages: The licence restricts some commercial use and setup is research-grade.

name: Flint
description: Flint is an all-in-one AI platform for K-12 teachers that uses an AI teaching assistant called Sparky to personalize learning across subjects such as math, English, science, and world languages. Teachers can upload their own materials, create assignments, and track student progress, with LMS and SIS integrations. The platform reports use by many teachers and students daily.
short_description: AI platform for teachers to personalize learning for students

name: FloQast
description: FloQast automates the financial close, reconciliations, variance analysis, and compliance workflows on one audit-ready system. Its AI matches transactions, generates variance explanations from transactional data, and builds close checklists tailored to company size and stage. It integrates directly with ERPs and Excel.
short_description: AI-powered accounting and financial close automation

name: Flowise
description: Open-source drag-and-drop builder for LLM chains and agents on top of LangChain.
short_description: Open-source drag-and-drop builder for LLM chains and agents on top of LangChain.
advantages: Fastest way to prototype a LangChain chatbot and expose it as an API or embed widget.
disadvantages: Inherits LangChain's churn and breaks when node versions drift.

name: FLUX (Black Forest Labs)
description: Family of image models (schnell, dev, Pro, Kontext) with open weights and a hosted API from the original Stable Diffusion team.
short_description: Family of image models (schnell, dev, Pro, Kontext) with open weights and a hosted API from the original Stable Diffusion team.
advantages: Best prompt adherence and hand/text rendering of any open-weight image model, with Kontext adding instruction-based editing.
disadvantages: The dev weights are non-commercial, and the 12B model needs a 16GB+ GPU to run comfortably.

name: Fooocus
description: Simplified offline Stable Diffusion XL app that hides sampler settings behind a Midjourney-style prompt box.
short_description: Simplified offline Stable Diffusion XL app that hides sampler settings behind a Midjourney-style prompt box.
advantages: Produces good SDXL results with zero tuning, making it the easiest local generator to start with.
disadvantages: In maintenance mode and tied to SDXL, so it does not support newer models like Flux.

name: Forethought
description: Forethought is an AI agent platform that automates and supports customer service operations using specialized agents that work together. The site describes a Discover Agent for surfacing insights, a Solve Agent for omnichannel support, a Triage Agent for classification and routing, a QA Agent for quality scoring, and an AI Copilot that assists human agents. It is aimed at enterprise customer service teams across industries.
short_description: AI agent platform for customer support automation

name: Formative
description: Formative lets teachers build lessons, deliver real-time assessments, and track student progress in one interface. Its AI creation tool, Luna, helps build lessons and assessments, while auto-grading, live response monitoring, and real-time analytics let teachers adjust instruction on the fly.
short_description: AI-powered formative assessment and instruction

name: Framer AI
description: Framer AI is a set of AI features within the Framer web design platform that help users build sites without coding. Its Wireframer generates a responsive page with structure and starter content from a chat prompt, and AI Translate localizes an entire site into multiple languages. AI Plugins connect to leading models to generate images and rewrite text.
short_description: AI features inside the Framer web design platform
advantages: Generated pages are instantly live, responsive and editable in a polished design tool.
disadvantages: Hosted on Framer with no HTML or code export, though custom domains are supported.

name: Frase
description: Builds the brief from the top results, then drafts and fact-links against them.
short_description: Builds the brief from the top results, then drafts and fact-links against them.
advantages: Research and drafting in one place, with the sources kept beside the text.
disadvantages: The writer is average on its own - the brief is what you are paying for.

name: Freddy AI
description: Freddy AI is Freshworks' customer service AI, with AI agents that autonomously resolve routine queries across chat, messaging apps, and email. It adds an agent copilot for reply suggestions and summaries, plus AI insights for leaders and a studio for building custom agents.
short_description: AI takes care of the busywork. You focus on what matters.

name: Freed
description: Freed is an AI medical scribe that converts patient conversations into clinical notes to reduce manual documentation. It offers one-click integration with browser-based EHR systems, visit preparation summaries, and code generation. It is aimed at individual clinicians and small to midsized practices across many specialties.
short_description: AI medical scribe that turns patient conversations into clinical notes

name: Freepik AI Suite
description: Freepik's AI toolbox bundling image generation, upscaling (via Magnific), video generation and its stock library.
short_description: Freepik's AI toolbox bundling image generation, upscaling (via Magnific), video generation and its stock library.
advantages: Access to Flux, Imagen, Kling, Veo and Magnific upscaling bundled with a stock library in one subscription.
disadvantages: The interface is cluttered with upsells and credit costs differ per model.

name: Fyxer AI
description: Sorts the inbox and drafts replies in your voice, plus meeting notes.
short_description: Sorts the inbox and drafts replies in your voice, plus meeting notes.
advantages: Learns from your sent mail, so the drafts sound like you.
disadvantages: Needs broad mailbox access, and the free tier is thin.

name: Gamma
description: Generates presentations, documents and web pages from a prompt or outline with a card-based layout engine.
short_description: Generates presentations, documents and web pages from a prompt or outline with a card-based layout engine.
advantages: The best-looking AI-generated decks with the least fiddling, and it exports to PowerPoint and PDF.
disadvantages: Exports lose some formatting, and the free tier watermarks and limits AI credits.

name: GC AI
description: GC AI is an AI platform for corporate counsel that drafts, reviews and analyses contracts and legal documents. It provides verifiable, clickable citations and works inside the documents legal teams are already drafting.
short_description: An AI platform built for in-house legal teams

name: Gem
description: Gem combines AI agents with an applicant tracking system and recruiting CRM, offering sourcing, scheduling, analytics, and talent marketing, usable as standalone agents alongside an existing ATS or as a complete platform.
short_description: The AI-first all-in-one recruiting platform.

name: Gemini
description: Google's assistant with Deep Research reports, Gmail/Docs/Drive integration and YouTube video understanding.
short_description: Google's assistant with Deep Research reports, Gmail/Docs/Drive integration and YouTube video understanding.
advantages: Deep Research produces long cited reports from dozens of sources, and it reads your Gmail, Drive and Calendar directly when you allow it.
disadvantages: Quality swings between Flash and Pro models, and it refuses or hedges on some topics more than competitors.

name: Gemini CLI
description: Open-source terminal agent that brings Gemini into your shell for coding and automation tasks.
short_description: Open-source terminal agent that brings Gemini into your shell for coding and automation tasks.
advantages: Free tier gives a 1M-token context window and around 1,000 requests per day.
disadvantages: Less reliable at multi-step edits than Claude Code and quietly falls back to Flash under load.

name: Gemini Image (Nano Banana)
description: Google's image generation and editing model inside the Gemini app, known for consistent subject edits across reference photos.
short_description: Google's image generation and editing model inside the Gemini app, known for consistent subject edits across reference photos.
advantages: Keeps faces and products consistent across multi-turn edits better than most editors.
disadvantages: Outputs carry a visible SynthID watermark and resolution tops out lower than dedicated generators.

name: Genie AI
description: Genie AI is a legal assistant platform that drafts, reviews, edits and negotiates contracts, learning an organisation's standards and applying them consistently. It works in Microsoft Word and connects to common business systems.
short_description: A legal brain for every business team

name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant that provides code completion and suggestions in the editor, chat for explanations and problem-solving, an agent mode for autonomous task execution, CLI support, and code review on pull requests.
short_description: AI coding assistant for completion, chat, and agent tasks
advantages: Deepest GitHub integration: assign an issue to Copilot and it opens a PR.
disadvantages: Completions and agent lag behind Cursor and Claude Code in quality despite more models being offered.

name: Glasp
description: A social web highlighter with AI summaries of articles and YouTube videos that feeds your highlights into a personal knowledge base.
short_description: A social web highlighter with AI summaries of articles and YouTube videos that feeds your highlights into a personal knowledge base.
advantages: One-click YouTube transcript and summary plus highlight export to Notion, Obsidian and Readwise.
disadvantages: The social feed and public highlights by default are not what everyone wants, and the AI features feel bolted on.

name: Glean
description: Glean is an enterprise AI platform that indexes data across more than 100 connected applications so employees can search across their tools. It provides an AI assistant for finding answers and generating content, plus agents to automate repetitive workflows, with real-time permissions enforcement.
short_description: Work AI platform with enterprise search, assistant, and agents

name: Gong
description: Gong is a revenue AI platform that captures and analyses customer interactions across the sales process. It provides revenue intelligence, sales engagement, forecasting, and enablement, plus AI agents that automate follow-ups, pipeline updates, and CRM entries.
short_description: Revenue AI that captures and analyses customer interactions
advantages: Flags deal risk and talk-ratio patterns across every rep's calls, which managers use for coaching and forecasting.
disadvantages: Enterprise-priced with annual contracts and per-seat plus platform fees.

name: Google Agent Development Kit
description: Open-source framework for building and deploying multi-agent systems, optimised for Gemini and Vertex AI.
short_description: Open-source framework for building and deploying multi-agent systems, optimised for Gemini and Vertex AI.
advantages: First-class deployment to Vertex AI Agent Engine and support for the A2A protocol.
disadvantages: Documentation and examples skew heavily to Google Cloud.

name: Google Translate
description: Free translation for 240+ languages with camera, conversation and website translation.
short_description: Free translation for 240+ languages with camera, conversation and website translation.
advantages: Unmatched language coverage and instant camera translation of signs and menus offline.
disadvantages: Output is often literal and stilted compared with DeepL or an LLM for nuanced text.

name: Google Veo
description: Google's video generation model (Veo 3) with native audio, available in Gemini, the Flow filmmaking tool and Vertex AI.
short_description: Google's video generation model (Veo 3) with native audio, available in Gemini, the Flow filmmaking tool and Vertex AI.
advantages: Generates dialogue, sound effects and ambient audio in sync with the video in one pass.
disadvantages: Clips are short (8 s), expensive per generation and access depends on region and plan tier.

name: Goose
description: Open-source, extensible local AI agent that automates engineering tasks via MCP extensions.
short_description: Open-source, extensible local AI agent that automates engineering tasks via MCP extensions.
advantages: MCP-first design means any MCP server becomes a Goose capability with no glue code.
disadvantages: Less tuned for coding than Claude Code, so results vary widely by model.

name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is a conversational AI platform and helpdesk built for ecommerce brands to automate support and assist shopping. The site describes an AI Agent for support and shopping, a unified omnichannel inbox across email, chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook, native Shopify integration with live order data, revenue attribution reporting, and 300+ integrations. It is aimed at ecommerce brands, with emphasis on Shopify.
short_description: Conversational AI helpdesk for ecommerce

name: GPT4All
description: Desktop app for running local LLMs with built-in chat over your own documents.
short_description: Desktop app for running local LLMs with built-in chat over your own documents.
advantages: LocalDocs lets you chat with folders of files with no extra setup.
disadvantages: Development has slowed and model support lags newer releases.

name: GPTZero
description: An AI-text detector for educators with sentence-level highlighting and a writing-process report.
short_description: An AI-text detector for educators with sentence-level highlighting and a writing-process report.
advantages: Highlights which sentences look AI-generated and offers a Google Docs writing replay as supporting evidence.
disadvantages: Like all detectors it produces false positives, particularly on non-native English writers.

name: Gradescope
description: Gradescope digitises grading for paper assignments, digital work, and code submissions, applying customisable rubrics across a class. Its AI-assisted grouping clusters similar student answers so instructors can grade them together, and per-question analytics surface performance patterns.
short_description: AI-assisted grading and assessment

name: Grammarly
description: Grammarly is an AI writing assistant that helps people write more clearly and professionally. It corrects grammar, spelling, and punctuation, suggests tone adjustments while preserving voice, rewrites paragraphs for clarity, and offers generative writing, plagiarism checking, paraphrasing, and citation tools.
short_description: AI writing assistant for clear, on-tone communication
advantages: Works in nearly every text field on every platform, so corrections and tone suggestions follow you into Gmail, Slack and Word.
disadvantages: Suggestions can flatten a distinctive voice and the premium nag prompts in the free tier are constant.

name: Granola
description: A notepad that listens to your meeting from your computer audio (no bot) and merges your typed notes with an AI transcript.
short_description: A notepad that listens to your meeting from your computer audio (no bot) and merges your typed notes with an AI transcript.
advantages: No bot joins the call, and the final notes combine your own jottings with what was actually said.
disadvantages: Desktop-only capture means it cannot record a meeting you join from another device, and the free tier is a small trial.

name: Graphite
description: Stacked-PR workflow tool with Diamond, an AI reviewer that flags bugs on every pull request.
