advantages: The Rezi Score and keyword targeting are built around passing applicant-tracking filters.
disadvantages: Templates are plain by design, and AI bullet points can sound generic without editing.

name: Rillet
description: Rillet is an AI-native ERP focused on core accounting operations - general ledger, AR/AP, bank reconciliation, revenue recognition, and month-end close. Its Aura AI supports natural-language querying and workflow automation, enabling a continuous close with real-time reporting.
short_description: ERP rebuilt for the modern finance team.

name: Riverside
description: Records every guest locally in up to 4K, then edits by transcript.
short_description: Records every guest locally in up to 4K, then edits by transcript.
advantages: Local per-track recording survives a bad connection, which call software does not.
disadvantages: The AI editing is lighter than Descript's; the recording is the real value.

name: Robin AI
description: Robin AI is a contract platform that lets users review documents and ask legal questions to receive instant insights. It offers a chat interface for document conversations, advanced search across contracts, and obligation tracking with alerts. The company is based in London and serves enterprise legal teams.
short_description: AI contract software that reviews, analyses, and finalises contracts

name: Rodin (Hyper3D)
description: Image/text-to-3D generator producing high-detail PBR assets with quad topology options.
short_description: Image/text-to-3D generator producing high-detail PBR assets with quad topology options.
advantages: Produces some of the most detailed geometry and production-friendly quad meshes of the generators.
disadvantages: Generation is slower and the credit pricing is less transparent than Meshy's.

name: Roo Code
description: Cline fork with custom modes, boomerang subtasks, and more configurable agent behaviour.
short_description: Cline fork with custom modes, boomerang subtasks, and more configurable agent behaviour.
advantages: Custom modes (Architect, Code, Debug) and Orchestrator subtasks keep context small per step.
disadvantages: Rapid releases mean frequent regressions and settings sprawl, and roocode.com now serves Roomote, the same team's hosted agent, which makes the project's own home hard to find.

name: Rosebud AI
description: Browser platform that generates playable 2D/3D web games and assets from text prompts.
short_description: Browser platform that generates playable 2D/3D web games and assets from text prompts.
advantages: Goes from a text prompt to a shareable playable game in minutes without coding.
disadvantages: Games are simple web prototypes and cannot be exported to Unity or Unreal.

name: Rows
description: A modern spreadsheet with built-in AI analyst, data integrations and AI formula functions.
short_description: A modern spreadsheet with built-in AI analyst, data integrations and AI formula functions.
advantages: The AI Analyst reads your tables and suggests summaries and charts, and functions like ASK_OPENAI work right in cells.
disadvantages: It is yet another spreadsheet to migrate to, and it lacks the depth of Excel for complex models.

name: Runway
description: Runway is a generative AI platform for video creation, featuring its Gen video models for motion quality, prompt adherence, and visual fidelity. It also offers interactive world models and tools to create expressive digital characters from a single image.
short_description: AI video generation and world models
advantages: Aleph lets you edit existing footage with text instructions, which few competitors offer.
disadvantages: Credits burn fast and clips are limited to roughly 10 seconds per generation.

name: Rytr
description: Cheap short and long-form copy generator with tone presets.
short_description: Cheap short and long-form copy generator with tone presets.
advantages: The lowest price in the category, with tone controls that work.
disadvantages: Output is generic and needs editing; no brand-voice training.

name: Salesloft
description: Salesloft is a revenue orchestration platform that unifies sales engagement, revenue intelligence, conversation intelligence, deal management, and forecasting. The site describes Cadence for pipeline generation, Conversations for coaching, Deals for opportunity management, Forecast for accuracy, Rhythm for action prioritization, and Drift AI chat agents. It serves sales leaders, SDRs, account executives, revenue operations, and customer success teams.
short_description: Revenue orchestration platform for sales teams

name: Sapling
description: Writing assistant for support teams, with a free AI-content detector.
short_description: Writing assistant for support teams, with a free AI-content detector.
advantages: The detector is free and gives a per-sentence score.
disadvantages: Detection is a side feature - the product is really autocomplete for agents.

name: Scenario
description: Game-asset generation platform where studios train custom models on their art style and generate consistent 2D and 3D assets.
short_description: Game-asset generation platform where studios train custom models on their art style and generate consistent 2D and 3D assets.
advantages: Custom-trained models keep every generated asset on-style for a specific game.
disadvantages: Training good models needs a curated dataset and the tool is overkill for solo hobbyists.

name: SchoolAI
description: SchoolAI is an education platform offering teacher-designed AI learning environments, personalised tutoring, and real-time student progress tracking. Teachers build custom Spaces, monitor engagement through a dashboard, and use focused AI tools for creation and practice.
short_description: AI that connects teachers with every student.

name: SciSpace
description: A research workspace that searches papers, explains PDFs line by line and drafts literature reviews.
short_description: A research workspace that searches papers, explains PDFs line by line and drafts literature reviews.
advantages: The Copilot sidebar explains equations, tables and jargon in a paper you are reading without leaving the PDF.
disadvantages: The free tier is limited and the interface pushes upgrades aggressively.

name: screenshot-to-code
description: Open-source tool that converts a screenshot or mockup into HTML, Tailwind, React, or Vue code.
short_description: Open-source tool that converts a screenshot or mockup into HTML, Tailwind, React, or Vue code.
advantages: Simple, widely used, and works with GPT, Claude, or Gemini vision models you supply.
disadvantages: Produces one-off static code with no design-system awareness.

name: Scribeberry
description: Scribeberry is an AI medical scribe that listens to clinical encounters and generates structured notes ready for the EMR. It also automates form filling and supports many languages for in-person and virtual visits.
short_description: Finish charting in minutes, not twenty

name: SeekOut
description: SeekOut is an agentic AI recruiting platform that helps companies source, screen, and engage talent at scale across a large database of candidate profiles, with AI screening of inbound applicants against custom criteria.
short_description: Stop searching. Start hiring.

name: SEO.AI
description: SEO.AI is an automated SEO platform that researches, writes, links, and publishes SEO-optimized articles on a recurring schedule. It works to rank in both Google and AI assistants, connects to common CMS platforms, and offers approval controls for automatic, draft, or reviewed publishing.
short_description: Automated SEO content creation and publishing

name: Shortwave
description: An AI-first Gmail client whose assistant searches, summarizes, drafts and organizes your email in natural language.
short_description: An AI-first Gmail client whose assistant searches, summarizes, drafts and organizes your email in natural language.
advantages: Ask questions across your entire mailbox and have the assistant draft replies grounded in past threads.
disadvantages: Gmail-only, and the bundled-threads inbox model takes getting used to.

name: Sierra
description: Sierra is an enterprise AI customer service platform for building and deploying AI agents across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and voice. Its Ghostwriter feature creates agents from documentation or plain English, with analytics and an outcome-based pricing model.
short_description: Better customer experiences. Built on Sierra.
advantages: Agents take real actions (returns, bookings, account changes) with strong guardrails, and you pay only for resolved cases.
disadvantages: Enterprise sales process and pricing; not self-serve for small businesses.

name: Simplified
description: Design, copy and social scheduling in one workspace.
short_description: Design, copy and social scheduling in one workspace.
advantages: Writes the copy and schedules the post from the same place.
disadvantages: Jack of all trades - the design side is thinner than Canva.

name: Simplify
description: Autofills job applications and matches postings to your profile.
short_description: Autofills job applications and matches postings to your profile.
advantages: One-click autofill across Workday, Greenhouse and Lever.
disadvantages: Match quality depends on a well-filled profile, and some sites still break it.

name: Skyvern
description: Open-source platform that automates browser workflows using vision LLMs instead of brittle selectors.
short_description: Open-source platform that automates browser workflows using vision LLMs instead of brittle selectors.
advantages: Vision-based approach survives layout changes that break selector-based scripts.
disadvantages: Slow and token-hungry on long multi-page forms.

name: SlidesAI.io
description: Turns text into Google Slides or PowerPoint decks from inside the editor.
short_description: Turns text into Google Slides or PowerPoint decks from inside the editor.
advantages: Lives inside Google Slides, so what comes out is a native editable deck.
disadvantages: Layouts are templated and repeat quickly; images are stock.

name: smolagents
description: Minimal Python library for agents that write and execute code as their actions.
short_description: Minimal Python library for agents that write and execute code as their actions.
advantages: Code-as-action agents in about a thousand lines of core code that work with any Hub model.
disadvantages: Running model-written Python needs sandboxing, which is left mostly to you.

name: Sora
description: OpenAI's text- and image-to-video model with a storyboard editor and a social-style Sora app.
short_description: OpenAI's text- and image-to-video model with a storyboard editor and a social-style Sora app.
advantages: Sora 2 generates synchronized audio and dialogue with its video and the cameo feature inserts real people consistently.
disadvantages: Heavy content restrictions, watermarks on free output and generations fail or queue at peak times.

name: Soundraw
description: Royalty-free background music generator where you pick mood, genre and length and tweak the arrangement.
short_description: Royalty-free background music generator where you pick mood, genre and length and tweak the arrangement.
advantages: Clear perpetual license for videos and podcasts, and you can restructure a track's energy section by section.
disadvantages: Instrumental loops only; it cannot generate vocals or follow a detailed text prompt.

name: Sourcegraph
description: Sourcegraph indexes entire codebases to give humans and AI agents complete context for search, oversight, and large-scale change. It supports natural-language and deterministic code search plus cross-repository batch changes.
short_description: Code search and AI context across the whole codebase

name: Sourcery
description: AI code reviewer for GitHub and GitLab that also suggests refactors in your IDE.
short_description: AI code reviewer for GitHub and GitLab that also suggests refactors in your IDE.
advantages: Long track record on Python refactoring, with rule-based suggestions that stay deterministic.
disadvantages: Less thorough on large multi-language PRs than CodeRabbit or Greptile.

name: Spark Mail
description: Email client with AI writing, summaries and a priority inbox.
short_description: Email client with AI writing, summaries and a priority inbox.
advantages: A real cross-platform client with shared drafts, not a browser add-on.
disadvantages: The AI features are subscription-gated and it proxies your mail.

name: Speak
description: Speak is a language learning app centered on speaking out loud and getting instant feedback from an AI tutor called Speak Tutor. It offers a personalized curriculum that adapts to the learner and provides detailed explanations for corrections. Practice is available across multiple languages including French, Spanish, English, Korean, Italian, and Japanese.
short_description: Language learning app focused on conversational speaking practice
advantages: Gets you talking from the first lesson with open-ended AI conversations rather than tap-the-word drills.
disadvantages: Limited language selection and no meaningful free tier beyond a trial.

name: Speechify
description: A read-aloud app that turns web pages, PDFs, books and emails into speech with celebrity and natural voices.
short_description: A read-aloud app that turns web pages, PDFs, books and emails into speech with celebrity and natural voices.
advantages: Listens to anything you would otherwise read, including scanned pages via OCR, at up to 4.5x speed.
disadvantages: Aggressive upsells and auto-renewing annual billing generate frequent complaints.

name: Spellbook
description: Spellbook is an AI legal assistant that works directly inside Microsoft Word for commercial contract work. It can review and redline contracts, draft clauses and documents, answer contract questions with citations, and benchmark agreements against market standards.
short_description: AI contract review and drafting inside Microsoft Word

name: Spline AI
description: Browser 3D design tool with AI generation of objects, textures and scenes, exportable for interactive web use.
short_description: Browser 3D design tool with AI generation of objects, textures and scenes, exportable for interactive web use.
advantages: Generated objects land directly in a web-ready interactive 3D editor you can embed in sites.
disadvantages: AI generation is limited and the tool is really a 3D web design editor first.

name: Spotlight Reporting
description: Spotlight Reporting is a reporting, forecasting, dashboard, and consolidation platform that turns accounting data into visual financial reports, cash flow forecasts, and KPI dashboards. It includes AI suggestions to help interpret results and generate narrative, and integrates with Xero, QuickBooks, and Sage Intacct.
short_description: Reporting, forecasting, and dashboards for advisors

name: Stable Audio
description: Stability AI's text-to-audio generator for music and sound effects, with an open-weights variant.
short_description: Stability AI's text-to-audio generator for music and sound effects, with an open-weights variant.
advantages: Good at sound effects and samples as well as music, and trained on licensed audio for lower legal risk.
disadvantages: Tracks top out at a few minutes and vocals are weak compared with Suno or Udio.

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Open source image generator
short_description: Open source image generator

name: Stable Diffusion WebUI (AUTOMATIC1111)
description: The classic self-hosted browser UI for running Stable Diffusion models locally with extensions like ControlNet.
short_description: The classic self-hosted browser UI for running Stable Diffusion models locally with extensions like ControlNet.
advantages: Huge extension ecosystem and years of tutorials make almost any workflow achievable locally.
disadvantages: Development has slowed, newer models like Flux need forks (Forge), and setup is fiddly for non-technical users.

name: Stagehand
description: AI browser automation framework that mixes natural-language act/extract/observe with Playwright code.
short_description: AI browser automation framework that mixes natural-language act/extract/observe with Playwright code.
advantages: Lets you fall back to deterministic Playwright for the parts you want to keep reliable.
disadvantages: Best experience assumes Browserbase hosting; local use needs more configuration.

name: Stager AI
description: Stager AI automates real estate photo editing, virtual staging, and video creation using machine learning. It can furnish empty rooms across multiple design styles and supports edits like object removal, sky replacement, and lighting adjustment. The platform serves agents, photographers, and editing agencies, including high volume workflows via API.
short_description: AI photo editing and virtual staging for real estate listings

name: Stitch
description: Google Labs tool that generates UI designs and front-end code from text prompts or sketches.
short_description: Google Labs tool that generates UI designs and front-end code from text prompts or sketches.
advantages: Produces editable designs you can paste into Figma as well as HTML/CSS.
disadvantages: Experimental Labs product with generation caps and limited iteration.

name: StudyFetch
description: Turns your notes and slides into flashcards, quizzes and an AI tutor.
short_description: Turns your notes and slides into flashcards, quizzes and an AI tutor.
advantages: Builds practice material out of your own course material.
disadvantages: Output quality tracks how clean the upload is; the free tier is tight.

name: Styldod
description: Styldod is an AI media platform that transforms home photos into listing visuals while preserving structural integrity and applying compliance checks. It can batch-process up to 50 images in about a minute and offers expert editing services for complex jobs. It serves real estate agents, brokerages, MLS platforms, and enterprises.
short_description: AI media tools that turn home photos into listing-ready visuals

name: Sudowrite
description: An AI writing partner for fiction authors with tools to describe, brainstorm, rewrite and draft whole chapters from an outline.
short_description: An AI writing partner for fiction authors with tools to describe, brainstorm, rewrite and draft whole chapters from an outline.
advantages: Built for novelists: Story Bible keeps characters and lore consistent and it will write in your style rather than refusing dark themes.
disadvantages: Credit-based usage runs out quickly when drafting at scale, and generated prose still needs a human pass.

name: Suki
description: Suki is an AI clinical assistant that captures patient conversations to generate notes, patient instructions, and orders, with voice-enabled editing. It integrates directly with major EHRs including Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth, and MEDITECH. It supports clinicians across many specialties and is available on iOS, Android, and desktop.
short_description: Ambient AI assistant for clinical documentation

name: Sully.ai
description: Sully.ai provides AI agents that handle administrative, clinical and operational tasks across healthcare settings, from patient check-in to documentation and coding. The agents take on roles such as scribe, receptionist, medical coder and interpreter.
short_description: A team of AI employees for hospitals

name: summarize.tech
description: Paste a YouTube link and get a section-by-section text summary of the video.
short_description: Paste a YouTube link and get a section-by-section text summary of the video.
advantages: No account or extension needed; paste a URL and the summary is there in seconds.
disadvantages: Only works on videos with existing captions, and the summaries are flat chunks without much structure.

name: Suno
description: Generates complete songs with vocals and lyrics from a text prompt.
short_description: Generates complete songs with vocals and lyrics from a text prompt.
advantages: Produces radio-ready full songs with sung vocals in any genre within a minute.
disadvantages: Commercial rights require a paid plan, and it is the subject of major-label copyright litigation.

name: Sunsama
description: Sunsama is a daily planner that brings tasks, calendar events, and time tracking into one focused workspace, with guided daily planning and shutdown rituals to help professionals manage workload across tools.
short_description: Start calm. Stay focused. End confident.

name: Superhuman
description: A keyboard-driven email client for Gmail and Outlook with AI drafting in your voice, inbox triage and auto-summaries.
short_description: A keyboard-driven email client for Gmail and Outlook with AI drafting in your voice, inbox triage and auto-summaries.
advantages: Write with AI learns your sent mail and produces replies that sound like you, and Auto Summarize puts a one-line gist atop every thread.
disadvantages: Expensive for an email client, and it only works on Gmail and Microsoft 365 accounts.

name: Supermaven
description: Supermaven is an AI code completion tool offering contextual suggestions across major editors with a 1 million token context window. It emphasizes low latency and codebase awareness for large projects.
short_description: Fast AI code completion with a large context window

name: Surfer SEO
description: Surfer is a content optimization platform that gives real-time SEO feedback through a Content Score and analyzes search results to guide on-page writing. It includes AI-assisted content generation, content auditing, topic discovery, and tracking of visibility across Google and AI tools. The site states it supports multiple languages and is used by content creators, SEOs, agencies, and teams.
short_description: SEO content optimization and AI visibility platform
advantages: The content score is the clearest brief a writer can be handed.
disadvantages: Optimising to the score produces pages that read like they were optimised to a score.

name: Surya
description: OCR, layout and reading-order models covering 90+ languages, weights included.
short_description: OCR, layout and reading-order models covering 90+ languages, weights included.
advantages: Beats the old OCR engines on messy scans and non-Latin scripts, locally.
disadvantages: The licence is not plain open source above a revenue line - read it before shipping.

name: Synthesia
description: Synthesia is an AI video creation platform that produces studio-quality videos using AI avatars and voices in 160+ languages, without traditional filming. It includes an AI video generator from text and documents, one-click translation and dubbing, brand kits, collaboration, and SCORM export for learning systems.
short_description: AI video platform with avatars and 160+ language voices
advantages: Mature enterprise features (SCORM export, brand kits, SOC 2, collaboration) for training content at scale.
disadvantages: Avatars look corporate and the free/starter tiers allow only a few minutes of video per month.

name: Synthflow
description: No-code voice assistants wired to a calendar, a CRM and a phone number.
short_description: No-code voice assistants wired to a calendar, a CRM and a phone number.
advantages: Books appointments and writes to a CRM without anyone writing code.
disadvantages: The ceiling is the builder - unusual logic ends up fought rather than written.

name: Tabnine
description: Tabnine is an AI coding assistant offering intelligent code completion and generation, AI chat across the software lifecycle, and agentic workflows for planning, coding, testing, and documentation. Its enterprise context engine maps an organisation's architecture and standards, with zero data retention and SaaS, on-premises, or air-gapped deployment options.
short_description: Privacy-first AI coding assistant with enterprise context

name: Tailor Brands
description: Logo maker that sells the whole brand kit and business filings around it.
short_description: Logo maker that sells the whole brand kit and business filings around it.
advantages: Gives a whole kit - logo, colours, social sizes - in one pass.
disadvantages: Free preview only, the files cost, and the upsells never stop.

name: Tana
description: Tana combines native video calls with AI agents that act during the conversation, creating documents, filing issues, and updating a structured knowledge graph rather than only recording and summarising afterward. Changes proposed by the AI require human approval.
short_description: An agentic meeting platform - work gets done in the meeting, not after.

name: Taplio
description: LinkedIn-only: post ideas from what is working now, scheduling, and lead lists.
short_description: LinkedIn-only: post ideas from what is working now, scheduling, and lead lists.
advantages: Being one-network means the suggestions are drawn from posts that performed on that network.
disadvantages: One network, and LinkedIn's rules on automation change without notice.

name: Taskade
description: Taskade lets users build business apps, AI agents, and automated workflows from natural language prompts without code, including dashboards, CRMs, client portals, and trackers, with integrations to external applications.
short_description: Apps, agents, automations - all in one workspace.

name: Tavus
description: Developer platform for real-time conversational video avatars and personalized video generation from a digital replica.
short_description: Developer platform for real-time conversational video avatars and personalized video generation from a digital replica.
advantages: Real-time face-to-face conversational agents with low latency for building video-first apps.
disadvantages: Priced and designed for developers, not for individual creators making one-off videos.

name: TeachBetter.ai
description: TeachBetter.ai bundles more than 20 AI tools with over 100 interactive science and maths simulations on one platform. Teachers generate curriculum-aligned lessons, worksheets, quizzes, and presentations, while students get a concept mastery coach, document chat, and a YouTube video analyser. PaperQR enables device-free paper quizzes with instant scanning.
short_description: 20+ AI teaching tools plus interactive simulations

name: Teachmate
description: Teachmate is an AI assistant for educators offering more than 150 tools, including an open chat for planning, a differentiated worksheet generator, lesson plans, presentations, and student reports. It uses education-specific AI models, is GDPR compliant, and does not train on user data.
short_description: 150+ AI tools for teachers

name: Teal
description: A job-search hub with an AI resume builder, job tracker and resume-to-job matching scores.
short_description: A job-search hub with an AI resume builder, job tracker and resume-to-job matching scores.
advantages: Save jobs from any board with the extension and tailor your resume to each with keyword match scores.
disadvantages: Weekly billing for the paid tier and limited AI generations on the free plan.

name: Tennr
description: Tennr is an agentic patient orchestration platform that automates referral processing, insurance verification and care routing. It classifies incoming patient data from faxes and portals and drives placement decisions based on authorization status and medical necessity.
short_description: Right patient, right care setting, every time

name: Textio
description: Textio is an HR platform that uses purpose-built AI to improve workplace communication. It helps managers deliver growth-oriented performance feedback in the moment, supports recruiters in writing inclusive job communications aligned to employer branding, and helps teams document and align interview feedback.
short_description: AI guidance for recruiting and performance feedback

name: Tidio
description: Tidio is a customer service platform that combines AI and human support tools to help businesses scale service. The site describes the Lyro AI agent for handling conversations, a help desk for organizing workflows, live chat, automation flows for proactive engagement, and integration with 120+ tools including Shopify, HubSpot, and Mailchimp. It serves businesses from SMBs through enterprise across many industries.
short_description: Customer service platform with the Lyro AI agent
advantages: Combines live chat, email inbox and the Lyro AI agent in one affordable tool with Shopify and WordPress plugins.
disadvantages: Lyro conversations are metered separately, so costs climb as the bot gets busier.

name: Tipalti
description: Tipalti is a finance automation suite covering accounts payable, mass payments, procurement, expense management, and treasury. Its AI automates invoice processing, payment reconciliation, and workflow optimisation, and supports cross-border payments to over 200 countries in 120 currencies.
short_description: AI-driven finance and accounts payable automation

name: tl;dv
description: tl;dv records, transcribes, and summarises meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams in multiple languages, extracts action items, and pushes insights into CRMs and other business tools.
short_description: Too long, didn't view - AI meeting notes and recaps.
advantages: Multi-meeting reports surface recurring topics and customer objections across weeks of calls.
disadvantages: Transcript accuracy and language support trail Otter and Fireflies, and the free tier has heavy limits on AI notes.

name: tldraw Make Real
description: Draw a UI sketch on a tldraw canvas and have an LLM turn it into a working web page.
short_description: Draw a UI sketch on a tldraw canvas and have an LLM turn it into a working web page.
advantages: Iterative loop: annotate the generated output on the canvas and regenerate.
disadvantages: It is a demo of the tldraw SDK rather than a maintained product.

name: Together AI
description: Inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source models like Llama, DeepSeek, and Qwen.
short_description: Inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source models like Llama, DeepSeek, and Qwen.
advantages: Broad open-model catalogue plus fine-tuning and dedicated GPU endpoints.
disadvantages: No proprietary models, so you cannot route to GPT or Claude.

name: Topaz Gigapixel AI
description: Dedicated image upscaler with generative models for enlarging photos up to 16x.
short_description: Dedicated image upscaler with generative models for enlarging photos up to 16x.
advantages: Multiple purpose-built models (Recover, Redefine) handle faces, low-res scans and art differently.
disadvantages: Generative models need a beefy GPU or cloud credits, and results can over-smooth textures.

name: Topaz Photo AI
description: Desktop app that denoises, sharpens, upscales and recovers faces in photos using trained models.
short_description: Desktop app that denoises, sharpens, upscales and recovers faces in photos using trained models.
advantages: Best-in-class noise reduction and sharpening for real photographs without hallucinating detail.
disadvantages: Expensive upfront cost plus paid annual upgrades, and it is slow on older machines.

name: Topaz Video AI
description: Desktop app that upscales, denoises, deinterlaces, stabilizes and frame-interpolates video.
short_description: Desktop app that upscales, denoises, deinterlaces, stabilizes and frame-interpolates video.
advantages: The standard for restoring old or low-resolution footage to 4K with slow-motion interpolation.
disadvantages: Very slow renders without a high-end GPU and the price is steep for hobbyists.

name: TORTUS
description: TORTUS is an AI medical scribe that listens to clinical consultations and creates patient notes. It integrates with EHR workflows and is used across primary and secondary care settings including general practice and emergency departments.
short_description: AI medical scribe that listens to consultations and drafts patient notes

name: Trae
description: Free AI-powered IDE from ByteDance with chat, builder mode, and frontier model access.
short_description: Free AI-powered IDE from ByteDance with chat, builder mode, and frontier model access.
advantages: Generous free access to Claude and GPT models compared with other editors.
disadvantages: ByteDance ownership raises data-residency concerns and the free tier queues under load.

name: Tripo
description: Image/text-to-3D generator with rigging, animation and PBR texturing, from the team behind the open TripoSR model.
short_description: Image/text-to-3D generator with rigging, animation and PBR texturing, from the team behind the open TripoSR model.
advantages: Among the cleanest geometry of the hosted generators, with built-in auto-rig and animation presets.
disadvantages: Fine detail and texture quality still trail hand-made assets and credits run out quickly.

name: Trolto
description: Trolto creates custom marketing content for an agent's local market, builds their website, and works to get them found on Google and ChatGPT. It generates weekly social posts, local blogs, and listing materials, learns the agent's voice, and posts automatically across channels.
short_description: Done-for-you AI marketing for real estate agents

name: Turnitin
description: The dominant academic plagiarism checker, with an AI-writing indicator built into its similarity reports.
short_description: The dominant academic plagiarism checker, with an AI-writing indicator built into its similarity reports.
advantages: Already deployed at most universities, so AI scores appear inside the workflow instructors use.
disadvantages: No individual access, and its AI indicator has led to disputed accusations against students.

name: Twee
description: Twee is an AI platform for language and ESL teachers that generates lesson materials aligned to CEFR levels across multiple languages. It produces texts, dialogues, gap-fill exercises, quizzes, and writing prompts, and can grade student responses automatically.
short_description: Tweak your lessons with the power of AI.

name: Udio
description: Text-to-music generator aimed at higher audio fidelity and fine control over song sections.
short_description: Text-to-music generator aimed at higher audio fidelity and fine control over song sections.
advantages: Often cleaner, more musical output than Suno with extend and inpaint tools to rework sections.
disadvantages: Late-2025 label settlements pulled download options, keeping generated songs walled inside the platform.

name: Uizard
description: Uizard is a cloud-based UI and UX design tool that generates and iterates on product designs through text prompts and visual inputs. Its Autodesigner feature creates designs from text, and it can convert screenshots into mockups and digitize hand-drawn wireframes. It supports interactive prototyping and real-time team collaboration.
short_description: AI-powered UI and UX design and prototyping tool
advantages: Screenshot-to-editable-design and sketch scanning make early-stage mockups very fast.
disadvantages: Designs look generic and the editor is far less capable than Figma for refinement.

name: Undetectable AI
description: Rewrites AI text to read as human and scores it against common detectors.
short_description: Rewrites AI text to read as human and scores it against common detectors.
advantages: Shows detector scores before and after, so the claim is checkable.
disadvantages: Using it to pass a school or client check breaks most of their rules, and rewrites flatten nuance.

name: Unity AI (formerly Muse)
description: AI assistant and sprite/texture/animation generators built into the Unity Editor.
short_description: AI assistant and sprite/texture/animation generators built into the Unity Editor.
advantages: The assistant understands your open project and can write scripts and generate assets in place.
disadvantages: The rebrand from Muse and shifting pricing have confused users, and generators are basic.

name: Unstructured
description: Ingest library and hosted pipeline that normalises 25+ file types into chunks for retrieval.
short_description: Ingest library and hosted pipeline that normalises 25+ file types into chunks for retrieval.
advantages: The connector list is the real product - S3, SharePoint, Confluence and Drive land as clean chunks.
disadvantages: The open library's best parsing paths push you toward the paid API.

name: Upscayl
description: Free open-source desktop upscaler built on Real-ESRGAN models with a simple drag-and-drop interface.
short_description: Free open-source desktop upscaler built on Real-ESRGAN models with a simple drag-and-drop interface.
advantages: Completely free, runs offline on almost any GPU and batch-processes folders.
disadvantages: Only deterministic upscaling, so it cannot add believable detail like Magnific or Gigapixel.

name: UX Pilot
description: UX Pilot generates wireframes and high fidelity screens from prompts and uploaded sketches, PDFs, or screenshots. It can explore multiple design variations at once and export work to Figma or production ready code. The tool is aimed at product managers, designers, and product teams looking to speed up the design cycle.
short_description: AI tool for generating wireframes and high fidelity UX designs

name: v0
description: v0 generates working web applications from text prompts and visual designs, with a live preview and design mode for refinement. Generated code can be pushed to GitHub and deployed to production on Vercel in one click.
short_description: Build full-stack web apps with AI, then deploy in seconds
advantages: Output uses shadcn/ui and Next.js idiomatically, so it drops straight into real projects.
disadvantages: Heavily biased to the Vercel stack; other frameworks get worse results.

name: Vapi
description: Voice agents that answer and place phone calls, assembled from your choice of model, voice and transcriber.
short_description: Voice agents that answer and place phone calls, assembled from your choice of model, voice and transcriber.
advantages: Every layer is swappable, so a bad voice or a slow model is a config change, not a migration.
disadvantages: You are renting orchestration and paying for the parts separately - the bill is four line items, not one.

name: VEED
description: VEED is an AI video creation and editing platform that turns text prompts into complete videos in multiple formats. It adds intelligent subtitles, brand kits, and audio enhancement for social-ready content.
short_description: AI videos worth posting, in minutes
advantages: Accurate auto-subtitles and a broad toolset without installing anything.
disadvantages: Browser rendering is slow for long projects and the free plan watermarks exports.

name: Vercel AI SDK
description: TypeScript toolkit for streaming LLM responses, tool calls, and agents across providers and UI frameworks.
short_description: TypeScript toolkit for streaming LLM responses, tool calls, and agents across providers and UI frameworks.
advantages: Unified provider interface and React hooks make streaming chat UIs trivial.
disadvantages: Major-version upgrades have required significant rewrites.

name: Vic.ai
description: Vic.ai is an AI finance platform that automates accounts payable. It processes invoices without manual data entry or templating, streamlines approvals and purchase order matching, and offers bill pay, a vendor portal, expense management, and real-time analytics, integrating with major ERP systems.
short_description: Autonomous AI platform for accounts payable and accounting

name: Vizard
description: Auto-clipping tool that cuts long recordings into subtitled social clips with a built-in editor.
short_description: Auto-clipping tool that cuts long recordings into subtitled social clips with a built-in editor.
advantages: Generous free minutes and a solid editor for tweaking clips after auto-selection.
disadvantages: Clip selection quality is inconsistent on multi-speaker or non-English content.

name: vLLM
description: High-throughput LLM serving engine with PagedAttention and an OpenAI-compatible server.
short_description: High-throughput LLM serving engine with PagedAttention and an OpenAI-compatible server.
advantages: Serves many concurrent requests on GPUs far faster than llama.cpp-based tools.
disadvantages: Linux and NVIDIA-centric; painful on Mac or consumer hardware.

name: Wan (Wan2.x)
description: Alibaba's open-weight video generation models for text/image-to-video, runnable locally or via its web app.
short_description: Alibaba's open-weight video generation models for text/image-to-video, runnable locally or via its web app.
advantages: The strongest fully open video model, with a 1.3B variant that runs on consumer GPUs and broad ComfyUI support.
disadvantages: Local generation is slow (minutes per clip) and the larger 14B model needs a high-end GPU.

name: Warp
description: Warp is a modern terminal and agent orchestration platform that lets developers run multiple coding agents from one interface. It scales from local development to cloud workflows with model choice and enterprise governance.
short_description: An agentic development environment born from the terminal

name: Wayground
description: Wayground (formerly Quizizz) is an assessment and engagement platform with AI generators for questions, presentations, rubrics, lesson plans, math problems, and worksheets. It provides real-time student data and automated accommodations, integrating with major LMS systems.
short_description: AI-supported, but teacher-first.

name: Weglot
description: Translates a live website by proxy, machine first and human edits after.
short_description: Translates a live website by proxy, machine first and human edits after.
advantages: No code changes - it translates the rendered site and serves localized URLs.
disadvantages: Cost scales with traffic and page count.

name: WellSaid
description: Enterprise text-to-speech with a library of consistent studio voices for training, e-learning and corporate video.
short_description: Enterprise text-to-speech with a library of consistent studio voices for training, e-learning and corporate video.
advantages: Voices are licensed from real actors with clear commercial rights and stay consistent across long narration projects.
disadvantages: No free tier and no voice cloning, which makes it pricier and less flexible than ElevenLabs for individuals.

name: Whisper
description: OpenAI's open-source speech-recognition model that transcribes and translates audio in dozens of languages, locally or via API.
short_description: OpenAI's open-source speech-recognition model that transcribes and translates audio in dozens of languages, locally or via API.
advantages: Free, runs fully offline, and remains the accuracy benchmark that most commercial transcription services are measured against.
disadvantages: No speaker diarization out of the box, it hallucinates text during silence, and large models are slow without a GPU.

name: Winston AI
description: AI text and image detector aimed at teachers and publishers, with reports.
short_description: AI text and image detector aimed at teachers and publishers, with reports.
advantages: Produces a shareable report and reads scanned documents with OCR.
disadvantages: Paid, and like every detector it mislabels non-native writing.

name: Wordtune
description: A rewriting tool that offers multiple alternative phrasings per sentence, plus summaries of articles and PDFs.
short_description: A rewriting tool that offers multiple alternative phrasings per sentence, plus summaries of articles and PDFs.
advantages: Shows several rewrite options per sentence so you keep authorship instead of accepting one AI version.
disadvantages: Free plan allows only a handful of rewrites per day.

name: Workable
description: Workable is an HR platform that posts jobs to many boards, parses resumes, and offers AI-assisted applicant screening with one-way video interviews. It also generates job descriptions and outreach emails, and adds onboarding, performance reviews, time tracking, and payroll.
short_description: All-in-one HR software spanning recruiting, employee management, and payroll

name: Writesonic
description: Writesonic tracks brand visibility across AI platforms and helps teams improve their presence in AI-generated answers. The site describes an Action Center that ranks optimization opportunities, AI agents that rewrite content and fix technical issues, and measurement of lift in citations and traffic. It is positioned for enterprise teams, agencies, growth teams, and e-commerce brands.
short_description: AI search visibility tracking and content optimization
advantages: The article writer pulls in SERP data and competitor outlines so drafts are structured for search.
disadvantages: Pricing and plan names change frequently, and long articles need heavy editing to avoid generic filler.

name: Yellow.ai
description: Yellow.ai is an enterprise agentic AI platform for customer service across voice, chat, and email. It supports multiple LLMs, an agent builder for rapid deployment, an agentic-RAG knowledge base, and 150+ pre-built integrations.
short_description: Smarter interactions with AI agents that think, act, and resolve

name: Ylopo
description: Ylopo runs a set of AI agents that work alongside real estate teams to generate, engage, and qualify buyer and seller leads. It pairs paid lead acquisition across Google, Facebook, and Instagram with conversational AI text and voice follow-up, plus long-horizon re-engagement on a branded IDX site, so agents can focus on leads that are ready to talk.
short_description: AI agents that find, engage, and qualify real estate leads

name: Zapier
description: The largest no-code automation platform, now with AI agents, chatbots, and an MCP server.
short_description: The largest no-code automation platform, now with AI agents, chatbots, and an MCP server.
advantages: 8,000-plus app integrations, more than any competitor.
disadvantages: Task-based pricing gets expensive fast at volume.

name: Zed
description: Zed is a code editor written in Rust that pairs high performance with native AI integration. Developers can delegate work to an agent, follow its progress live, and review changes inline alongside built-in Git and multi-language debugging.
short_description: A fast, multiplayer code editor with native AI agents
advantages: Startup and typing latency are far lower than any Electron-based AI editor.
disadvantages: Extension ecosystem is small compared with VS Code and Windows support only arrived in 2025.

name: Zendesk AI
description: Zendesk AI is the intelligence layer in Zendesk's service platform that learns from real interactions. It provides autonomous AI agents that resolve multi-step workflows across channels, a copilot that assists human agents with context and recommended actions, knowledge management, and AI-powered quality monitoring.
short_description: AI for autonomous resolution and agent assistance
advantages: Native to the ticketing system many support teams already run, with agent-assist as well as customer-facing bots.
disadvantages: Add-on pricing on top of Zendesk seats makes the total cost high, and setup needs admin effort.

name: Zeni
description: Zeni is an AI-powered finance platform that combines automated bookkeeping with banking, bill pay, employee reimbursements, and professional finance services. It categorises transactions, reconciles accounts, and generates real-time financial dashboards, pairing AI automation with human finance support.
short_description: AI bookkeeping software for startups and growing businesses.

name: ZeroGPT
description: Free in-browser detector that highlights the sentences it thinks are AI.
short_description: Free in-browser detector that highlights the sentences it thinks are AI.
advantages: No account needed for a quick check.
disadvantages: The least reliable of the mainstream detectors; false positives are common.
